
### PROMPT FOR: Alfa Romeo 156 ###
Subject: Alfa Romeo 156 (1997 – 2007)

Technical Specs:
- Camera: Sony A7R V (60MP+ Full Frame)
- Lens: 100mm Prime Lens (No distortion)
- Settings: f/8 aperture, 1/125s shutter, ISO 64
- Resolution: 8K (7680x4320), 16-bit RAW style

Composition:
- Angle: 3/4 front view looking at the corner of the car
- Orientation: Car facing LEFT
- Height: Camera at headlight level (approx. 24-30 inches)
- Framing: "Hero" cut, car fills 80% of frame, 100% visible (no cropping)

Lighting & Environment:
- Environment: Pure white "infinity cove" studio, seamless floor
- Key Light: Large overhead softbox (skylight style) creating rectangular reflection on windshield/roof
- Fill Light: Soft global white fill, no crushed black shadows
- Shadows: Realistic soft contact shadows under all 4 tires (15-25% opacity)

Vehicle Details:
- Color: Official Deep Obsidian Black, Midnight Blue, or Dark Grey (unless specified)
- Wheels: Front wheels turned 15-20 degrees AWAY from camera to show rim face
- Branding: Logos/Badges ultra-sharp and perfectly clear
- Condition: Showroom pristine, tire dressing, no dust

Style:
- Photorealistic, Automotive Commercial, Ultra-Detailed, Tangible Physics.
